ambiguity.detail: Unclear why the marriage wasn't registered despite the ceremony.

verdict.hook_line: Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!
verdict.cliffhanger_line: You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: Guards surround a duke while a priest invalidates his marriage, bringing joy to his rival.
verdict.why_it_works: The flash-forward cold open instantly hooks the viewer with drawn weapons before flashing back to the devastating wedding annulment.
